subject: Packrat with different versions of R

messages.author: 851baabb324f1dd1
messages.subject: Packrat with different versions of R
parts:
What is the correct workflow to be used with Packrat under such set-up:

in the office

-R3.1.0 installed locally in C:\

-RStudio installed locally in C:\

at home

-R3.1.1 installed on my portable USB pen

-RStudio installed on my portable USB pen

Consider I'm using R scripts from a GitHub repository or from my portable usb pen being shared both in the office and at home.

In particular is PackRat considering I'm using 2 different versions of R in the right way?

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: Packrat with different versions of R
parts:
Hi Paolo,

Right now, packrat doesn't do anything particularly special with the version of R it records -- when you start a new R session, packrat will double-check its version against that in the stored project lockfile, and just provide a warning if it doesn't match. Otherwise, everything else will proceed as-is.

The packrat private library is segmented in such a way that each version of R gets its own library, so you shouldn't have to worry about collisions there.

Thanks,
Kevin
